newsitem.title: USA: SIMEX weighs joining IPE-NYMEX cooperation talks.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX weighs joining IPE-NYMEX cooperation talks.

text.p: Elizabeth Sam, deputy chairwoman of the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX), said Thursday the exchange had been asked to participate in cooperation discussions between London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) and the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX).
"They have asked us whether we are interested in participating," she told Reuters in a telephone interview during a futures industry conference here. "We have said we will be looking at it."

NYMEX and IPE said Thursday they were discussing areas of cooperation that would create greater efficiency for customers, such as cross-margining, systems cooperation and a joint electronic trading system.
Sam declined to say whether SIMEX had been informed of the IPE-NYMEX discussions before Thursday's IPE-NYMEX announcement.
"It's (IPE-NYMEX talks) a very preliminary discussion," she said.
